svg.title: Splitting a full leaf
svg.desc: An animation in four steps of a B-tree index on players(rating). The root page has three downlinks to leaves that hold up to three ratings each, and the second leaf, with 4102, 4150, and 4171, is full. A new player finishes placement at rating 4135, and an entry for 4135 goes down from the root to that leaf. The leaf splits: 4150, 4171, and the leaf's high key, 4190, move to a new page on its right, 4135 goes in after 4102, and the sibling links are rewired so the new page sits between its neighbors. The left page gets 4150 as its new high key. Then 4150 is copied into the root with a downlink to the new page, and all four leaves sit one level below the root.
svg.text: An index on players(rating), drawn with three keys per leaf. Real pages hold many more.
A new player finishes placement at rating 4135. That is at least 4102 and below 4190, so the root sends it to the second leaf, which is full.
The leaf splits: 4150, 4171, and the high key 4190 move to a new right sibling, 4135 goes in on the left, and the links are rewired.
The left page gets a new high key: 4150, the first key on the new page. It now separates the two pages.
The parent, here the root, gets a downlink to the new page under 4150. Every leaf is still one level below the root.
